TicTacToeView - Class in org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.tictactoe
The tic-tac-toe board, rasterised into a single live texture following the AgendaGrid / MailView recipe: one fixed-size ImageComponent2D (FORMAT_RGBA, ALLOW_IMAGE_WRITE) is attached to a Texture2D once, off-live; every later change only repaints the BufferedImage and calls ImageComponent2D.set(java.awt.image.RenderedImage) in place, so no texture is ever re-attached to the live scene graph.
